committed-not-applied.json.why: committed data stays present: not-applied with archivePresent false

not-applied-on-unknown.json.why: unknown presence said as not applied

ended-incomplete.json.why: ended is written only after the final flush

bad-launch-id.json.why: upper-case hex: kiln.launch ids are written in lower case, as launch.json writes them

d2a-foreign-surface.json.why: under D2(a) kiln-sfi records only its own native surface

none-previous-with-id.json.why: no previous start has no id

unknown-presence-archive-known.json.why: unknown presence keeps archivePresent null, even when the data step failed

warning-sensitive-on-plain-package.json.why: a warning on a package that is not save-sensitive has no save-sensitive line

running-hosted-backend.json.why: kiln-sfi runs only when the frozen backend is kiln

launch-id-uuid.json.why: a uuid: kiln.launch ids are a u64 as 16 lower-case hex digits (launch.json)

kiln-launch-without-launch-id.json.why: a record from kiln.launch always has its launch id

previous-launch-id-uuid.json.why: the previous start id has the same 16-hex form

absent-source-with-launch-id.json.why: no kiln.launch table, so no launch id

carried-on-running.json.why: only aside and refused records carry a list; a kiln record lists its own packages

carried-on-ended.json.why: an ended record is a kiln record: it lists its own packages and carries nothing

carried-basis-none.json.why: a carried package is save-sensitive: basis none is not carried

carried-unknown-field.json.why: closed: a carried entry has five fields

carried-bad-from-launch-id.json.why: fromLaunchId is 16 lower-case hex digits or null

owner-epoch-zero.json.why: an owner epoch is 1 or more

owner-epoch-runtime-stopped.json.why: only a row whose runtime is active holds an owner epoch

owner-epoch-after-end.json.why: no owner epoch is current after the end
